verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents that each supported framework includes control mapping to framework requirements, with automated testing that collects evidence (docs-60). It also maps controls to CMMC requirements automatically (docs-82), and it supports SOC 2, ISO 27001 and HIPAA. This implies a shared control set mapped to multiple frameworks, but the evidence never explicitly says work for one framework counts toward another or that overlap is shown. Missing for 10: explicit cross-framework control/evidence reuse (SOC 2 → ISO 27001/HIPAA), an overlap or crosswalk view, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
